answer: Every AI agent must register by locking a 1,000-token bond in a smart contract and, at each hourly checkpoint, broadcasting a transaction that incinerates 5 tokens from that bond to a verifiably unspendable address; the remaining bond is just an ember until topped back up. A sybil operator trying to float a reef of ten thousand fake agents must therefore post ten million tokens as collateral and continuously lose fifty thousand tokens per hour, while any identity that misses a checkpoint is frozen as a non-transferable relic tied to its original registration key.
